test_names: forward candidate matches the deployed chain, preserves unrelated state and enables only reviewed contracts
a repeated deployment refuses to overwrite installed target contracts
the three public APIs are service-only and app callers cannot forge a privileged role
all new private tables deny direct reads and mutations even to the service role
current AAL1 and AAL2 staff sessions work while unknown and revoked identities are denied
all 11 roles match all 15 frontend action permissions and unknown permissions fail closed
commands validate operation, field names, field types, payload size and target identity
identical commands produce one result and audit; changed, cross-operation and cross-actor replays are denied
audit failure rolls back the action and receipt, allowing an identical successful retry
verification approval validates evidence and review basis, rejects self approval and synchronizes revocation
applicants cannot forge badges, decisions or another account application and evidence stays private
verification submissions reject duplicate pending requests and malformed evidence
verification evidence rejects backslashes before a misleading URL can enter the review queue
suspension revokes sessions, restoration and bounded strikes work, active staff are protected
reported removals bind the exact target and report decisions use valid states
reporters cannot submit a pre-resolved report or impersonate its resolver
listing removal retains order history and owners cannot restore, delete or reuse moderated identities
post, comment and story removals run with safe trigger search paths and prevent reused IDs
support replies are once-only and solve/reopen transitions clear resolution metadata
campaign review cannot forge funding or bypass allowed review states
last-super-admin protection and role changes retain active staff safety and session revocation
feature flags, announcements and blocked words validate and mutate the intended records
organization transfer and archive update ownership and revoke delegations atomically
business rejection needs a pending application and cannot race reserved provisioning
staff provisioning reserves only a new identity and finishes exactly once after trusted provider confirmation
provisioning rejects changed payloads, other actors, existing emails and unreserved finish
business provisioning uses delegated identity, protects application snapshot, bans direct sign-in and preserves owner email
provisioning audit failure keeps the reservation resumable and does not grant a partial staff role
deletion requests preserve Auth and financial history, revoke sessions and block unreviewed restoration
deletion queue is bounded and super-admin only; account owners must transfer ownership first
business provisioning rechecks every reviewed field before assigning a verified identity
business provisioning denies banned/deleted owners both at reservation and completion
a provider-created identity that has been banned cannot gain a new staff role
organization ownership cannot be transferred to a banned or deleted Auth identity

notes: Business reserve/finish binds all six reviewed fields and denies a banned/deleted owner.
A provider-created banned staff identity cannot be finished into an admin role.
Organization ownership transfer denies banned/deleted target identities.
Malformed reservation/completion receipts and missing trusted identity metadata do not report success or trigger unreserved provider creation.
Backslash-containing evidence URLs are rejected; the inherited LIKE expression had escaped the percent wildcard instead of matching a backslash.

rollout_order: Complete the matching admin UI validation and exact-response server helper deployment.
Run the combined admin/privacy/erasure candidate chain in isolated QA.
Repeat read-only preflight against the deployment target and compare with this tested catalog.
Apply exactly the reviewed candidate SHA as one transaction; abort on definition or target drift.
Run read-only postflight and compare every installed definition, privilege, trigger, preserved support RPC and native session hash.
Run intentional hosted staff-session and Auth reserve/create/finish acceptance with approved disposable fixtures.
remaining_acceptance: Hosted Auth Admin reserve/create/finish and resumable retries with real provider identity metadata.
Authenticated staff browser walkthrough of restored operations and denied-role behavior.
Multi-connection database lock/race acceptance; PGlite executes local cases on one connection.
Combined candidate integration with the separate media privacy and account Storage erasure changes.
Admin deletion requests remain retention_review and do not claim completed erasure.
